method: Primary-source repository documentation and selected interface/circuit/library files read through GitHub CLI. Sources pinned to commits; no third-party source vendored. Not a systematic literature review or experimental replication.

sources.title: Custom instruction allocation
sources.finding_and_limit: Custom-0 through custom-3 are the recommended custom major opcodes; reserved encodings are not a safe substitute. This is not a registered Xbt extension or a CPU integration.
sources.licensing_caution: Upstream terms remain separate; this research is not a full per-file license audit.

sources.title: Coprocessor protocol
sources.finding_and_limit: Issue/register/commit/result channels, speculative kill/commit and optional memory interfaces are explicit. Register widths/read counts are configured, not arbitrary 128-bit ternary registers. Match a specific core and specification revision.
sources.licensing_caution: Upstream terms remain separate; this research is not a full per-file license audit.

sources.title: A concrete RISC-V integration candidate
sources.finding_and_limit: The core exposes an extension interface; control-transfer instructions are not supported through it. Separate core verification infrastructure and compatible interface revisions remain required.
sources.licensing_caution: Upstream terms remain separate; this research is not a full per-file license audit.

sources.title: A small FPGA custom-function exploration route
sources.finding_and_limit: The README describes instruction/kernel/FPGA iteration and no-board simulation, supported board examples, and its prototype/not-officially-supported disclaimer. It is an alternative experiment, not a second mandatory SoC integration.
sources.licensing_caution: Upstream terms remain separate; this research is not a full per-file license audit.

sources.title: FPGA SoC and control infrastructure
sources.finding_and_limit: Buses, memory/peripheral generation, BIOS and CSR headers, host bridges and LiteScope are described. Proposed first control-plane host; none is integrated into Trium-XBT in this research.
sources.licensing_caution: Upstream terms remain separate; this research is not a full per-file license audit.

sources.title: Larger SoC route
sources.finding_and_limit: The framework covers RISC-V cores, MMIO/custom accelerators, simulation, FPGA-assisted simulation and VLSI flows. Consider later if Rocket/RoCC is chosen; not the same interface as CV-X-IF.
sources.licensing_caution: Upstream terms remain separate; this research is not a full per-file license audit.

sources.title: A relevant binary-hardware ternary-weight baseline
sources.finding_and_limit: Official inference framework describing CPU/GPU low-bit kernels. It demonstrates the category of binary-hardware optimization; upstream advertised performance is not a Trium measurement or an equal-workload comparison.
sources.licensing_caution: Upstream terms remain separate; this research is not a full per-file license audit.

sources.title: Actual HDL compilation and simulation
sources.finding_and_limit: Accepts SystemVerilog, performs lint and compiles simulation models into C++/SystemC. Reading an RTL file or incrementing a C++ cycle counter is not this process.
sources.licensing_caution: Upstream terms remain separate; this research is not a full per-file license audit.

sources.title: Independent Python-driven HDL tests
sources.finding_and_limit: Python testbenches for Verilog/VHDL; requires a simulator. A verification harness does not synthesize a chip or prove analog behavior.
sources.licensing_caution: Upstream terms remain separate; this research is not a full per-file license audit.

sources.title: RTL property checking
sources.finding_and_limit: Front end for Yosys-based formal flows; engines/components have separate terms and syntax support differs between open and commercial suites. A completed proof must report its assumptions and supported frontend.
sources.licensing_caution: Upstream terms remain separate; this research is not a full per-file license audit.

sources.title: RTL/netlist equivalence
sources.finding_and_limit: Yosys-based equivalence checking frontend. Use to check transformations where supported; not a substitute for an independently specified arithmetic reference.
sources.licensing_caution: Upstream terms remain separate; this research is not a full per-file license audit.

sources.title: Binary digital RTL-to-GDS flow
sources.finding_and_limit: Documents synthesis, floorplan, placement, clock tree, routing and finishing stages. Flow completion is not a foundry reservation, production signoff or physical ternary-cell implementation.
sources.licensing_caution: Upstream terms remain separate; this research is not a full per-file license audit.

sources.title: Current modular digital implementation option
sources.finding_and_limit: Current LibreLane README describes configurable reproducible implementation flows. The separately reviewed chipfoundry/openlane2 README explicitly points development here; use a pinned supported flow rather than assuming the old brand/repository is current.
sources.licensing_caution: Upstream terms remain separate; this research is not a full per-file license audit.

sources.title: Open process data and explicit maturity warning
sources.finding_and_limit: README calls this open release an experimental preview/alpha, intended for test chips and initial verification rather than production. A mature process does not make every public PDK release or ternary design production-qualified.
sources.licensing_caution: Upstream terms remain separate; this research is not a full per-file license audit.

sources.title: PDK preparation is a separate dependency
sources.finding_and_limit: Builds foundry data for open tools; sky130/gf180 support and prebuilt IHP distinction are documented. A PDK builder is not a ternary cell library, a fabrication contract or a generic advanced-node model.
sources.licensing_caution: Upstream terms remain separate; this research is not a full per-file license audit.

sources.title: Circuit/device simulation capability
sources.finding_and_limit: SPICE-compatible DC/transient/noise analyses and compact/custom models are described. Simulator capability does not validate a particular device model, PDK translation or fabrication process.
sources.licensing_caution: Upstream terms remain separate; this research is not a full per-file license audit.

sources.title: Author-supplied physical-ternary circuit research
sources.finding_and_limit: SPICE supplement to High-Density Memristor-CMOS Ternary Logic Family, DOI 10.1109/TCSI.2020.3027693. Includes circuit/model references and warns ordinary DC sweeps can be inaccurate for its time-dependent memristor model. Not independently simulated or treated as fabricated Trium hardware.
sources.licensing_caution: No repository-wide license grant was identified in the reviewed README/metadata; it explicitly notes original authors’ model copyrights. Review all files and obtain rights before reuse.

sources.title: Six-transition ternary timing research
sources.finding_and_limit: Research cells and extended Ternary Liberty data cover six ternary transitions; the actual std_cells.sp and ternary.lib headers/tables were inspected. Requires an external 32 nm Stanford CNTFET model; characterized with HSPICE per README. No independent reproduction, silicon qualification, or ordinary binary-STA parser compatibility is established.
sources.licensing_caution: README says a CC BY 4.0 license file will be added on publication; do not treat this announced future grant as resolved. The external CNTFET compact model is not redistributed and has separate terms.

sources.title: Research precedent for separating logical and physical mappings
sources.finding_and_limit: Author describes binary-CMOS mapping versus CNTFET-native SPICE generation and links design examples. Useful architectural precedent; README performance/fabrication/service availability claims were not independently checked.
sources.licensing_caution: Repository metadata identifies GPL-3.0; model dependencies and generated-output licensing require their own file-specific review.

local_audit.execution_scope: Source/document audit only. No new HDL lint, simulation, formal RTL proof, synthesis, FPGA run, circuit simulation or silicon test performed.
